source.text: 6.2 Delivery deadline. All Equipment covered by the relevant order must be delivered on or before 30 April 2027. The first three (3) days after that date shall be a penalty-free grace period. For each subsequent day of delay, a single daily penalty of 1% of the applicable invoice value shall accrue, subject to an overall maximum of 8% of that invoice value.
Where a single accepted purchase order includes fifty (50) or more units, the price of the Equipment covered by that order shall be reduced by 5%.
The Buyer shall pay each valid invoice within 25 days of the invoice date
The unit price for a Samsung 990 PRO 2TB NVMe SSD shall be PKR 62,000, and the invoice for that item shall not exceed that amount per unit.
